maddeler.e:
يحقان (form I)
# يَحِقَّانِ (yaḥiqqāni) /ja.ħiq.qaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يَحُقَّانِ (yaḥuqqāni) /ja.ħuq.qaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# يُحَقَّانِ (yuḥaqqāni) /ju.ħaq.qaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
